snippet.title: Faster Bunnies Release Trailer
snippet.description: Raise, race and breed bunnies in a roguelike management sim like you've never experienced! Synergize your stable managers' abilities with your bunnies' natures and breed your best racers together to get faster and faster with every generation before time runs out and you face the championship race!
